title: Petition of Boston Edison Company (a) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 72, as amended, for a determination that underground lines for the transmission of electricity are necessary, will serve the public convenience, and are consistent with the public interest; and (b) for a determination that locations upon, under, along, or across certain reservations and boulevards in the care and control of the Metropolitan District Commission will be and are required by public convenience and necessity for wires, cables, or pipes for the transmission of electricity, pursuant to the requirements of G.L. c. 92, § 43, as amended.
